steamu.bientot: Coming soon: SteamU can't read this file yet
steamu.guide.mii.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9. Turn it on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.mii.2: Open [1:] SYSNAND CTRNAND, then data, then the folder with the long name.
steamu.guide.mii.4: A on the file 00000005, then “Mount as DIFF image”. Say yes to open it.
steamu.guide.mii.5: A on partitionA.bin, then “Copy to 0:/gm9/out”. Those are your Mii!
steamu.guide.mii.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out › partitionA.bin.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.1: Without this key, the 3DS files that are still locked can't be read (Badge Arcade, menu sounds…). It comes from YOUR 3DS: SteamU never provides it.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.2: You need a 3DS with GodMode9. Turn it on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.3: Go down to [M:] MEMORY VIRTUAL and open it with A.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.4: A on the boot9.bin file, then « Copy to 0:/gm9/out ». That's the key!
steamu.guide.cle3ds.5: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out › boot9.bin.
steamu.guide.cle3ds.prudence: This key is yours: don't share it with anyone.
steamu.guide.luigi.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9 and your Super Mario 64 DS cartridge. Put the cartridge in the 3DS.
steamu.guide.luigi.2: Turn the 3DS on while holding START: GodMode9 opens.
steamu.guide.luigi.3: Open [C:] GAMECART: you see the game file, ending in .nds.
steamu.guide.luigi.4: A on the .nds file, then “Copy to 0:/gm9/out”.
steamu.guide.luigi.5: Do you also have Mario Party DS? Copy it the same way: Luigi will get all his moves.
steamu.guide.badges.1: You need a 3DS with GodMode9 and Badge Arcade installed. Turn it on while holding START.
steamu.guide.badges.2: Press HOME, choose “Title manager”, then [A:] SYSNAND SD.
steamu.guide.badges.3: Pick Badge Arcade with A, then “Open title folder”.
steamu.guide.badges.4: A on the biggest .app file, then “NCCH image options…” and “Mount image to drive”.
steamu.guide.badges.5: Go to the romfs folder and press Y to copy it to 0:/gm9/out.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.sous: 3DS (including Mii Maker and Mii Plaza), Wii U, Switch, Badge Arcade, casino
steamu.guide.sons3ds.1: Do you have console sounds (flac, wav, ogg, mp3, bcstm…)? SteamU listens to them one by one.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.2: Import them all at once, even mixed with other files.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.3: Each recognized sound goes to its place: menu, shop, button sounds… The others are left aside.
steamu.guide.wiiu.sous: The plaza, the menu, the eShop, Mii Maker
steamu.guide.wiiu.1: You need a modded Wii U (Aroma or Tiramisu) with the dumpling app, and an SD card or a USB stick.
steamu.guide.wiiu.2: On the Wii U, start dumpling.
steamu.guide.wiiu.3: Choose to copy the system applications, including the Wii U Menu. Wait until it's done.
steamu.guide.wiiu.4: Put the SD card (or the stick) here, then Import files: the dumpling folder.
steamu.guide.wiiu.5: Already have music files (ogg, mp3, m4a, wav, bfstm…)? Import them: SteamU recognizes each Wii U track by listening to it and puts it in its place.
steamu.guide.wiiu.prudence: We only copy: don't change anything else on the Wii U.
steamu.guide.switch.1: There is no simple, safe way to copy the Switch sounds, even from your own console.
steamu.guide.switch.2: Already have Switch sounds (ogg, mp3, wav, flac)? Import them: SteamU recognizes each sound by listening and puts it in its place.
steamu.guide.switch.prudence: Only the sounds SteamU recognizes are kept.

Hands: Pair < Two Pair < Three of a Kind < Full House < Four of a Kind < Flush (5 of a kind). Cards: Cloud < Mushroom < Flower < Luigi < Mario < Star.

casino.roulette_note: Up to 5 coins on the table. A coin on a color wins about half the time; on a picture, rarely, but pays 12 times the bet.

steamu.guide.moteur.1: Real Miis need two things: the engine and the faces file. The Your Miis assistant takes care of both. Faces and bodies are Nintendo files, SteamU is not allowed to ship them.
steamu.guide.moteur.2: You need just one file: the faces file, FFLResHigh.dat (Wii U) or AFLResHigh_2_3.dat (Miitomo). Scan the code to find out where to get it, then press "Import". By importing the faces, you agree that SteamU also downloads the real Mii bodies and logo; without them, SteamU draws its own.
steamu.guide.moteur.3: After you import the faces, SteamU also downloads the Mii Maker logo and turns it into its icon.
steamu.guide.moteur.qr1: Where to find the faces file
steamu.guide.luigi.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out.
steamu.guide.badges.6: Turn the 3DS off. Put its SD card here, then Import files: gm9 › out. Add boot9.bin too (3DS key guide) for locked files.
steamu.guide.sons3ds.prudence: Only the sounds SteamU recognizes are kept.
steamu.guide.moteur.prudence: Nothing is downloaded without your OK.

luigi.vrai.accueil_3: Come on in! Luigi runs this place… not Mario!
luigi.vrai.accueil_4: Good evening, good evening! A quick game before bed?
luigi.vrai.accueil_5: Come closer, come closer! The dealer doesn't bite.
luigi.vrai.cartes_1: Shuffling the cards… just like the good old days!
luigi.vrai.cartes_2: Star, mushroom, flower… Oh wait, that's the other game.
luigi.vrai.cartes_3: Watch my hands closely… Hop! You didn't see a thing.
luigi.vrai.cartes_4: One card for you, one card for me… Heh heh.
luigi.vrai.designer_1: That one! I've got a good feeling about that one.
luigi.vrai.designer_2: Psst… This one looks generous today.
luigi.vrai.designer_3: Go on, try that one. Luigi has a nose for this!
luigi.vrai.designer_4: Look: this one blinks brighter than the others!
luigi.vrai.gagne_3: Wahoo! Even Mario couldn't have done better!
luigi.vrai.gagne_4: Bravo! You're going to clean out my casino!
luigi.vrai.rate_2: Oh no… The claw slipped. It wasn't me, I promise!
luigi.vrai.rate_3: Don't worry, I miss too. Often. Very often.
luigi.vrai.salut_1: See you soon! I'll keep your seat warm.
luigi.vrai.salut_2: Ciao! Come back soon, the badges will get bored.
luigi.vrai.salut_3: See you next time! Luigi's casino never closes.
luigi.vrai.noeud_1: Always dressed to the nines, this dealer!
luigi.vrai.noeud_2: A dealer always minds his bow tie. Hm hm.
luigi.vrai.attente_1: So, can't make up your mind?
luigi.vrai.attente_3: Word is there are new badges today…
luigi.vrai.attente_4: Take your time… Luigi's got all night.
luigi.vrai.attente_5: Psst! The machine at the back… Never mind.

arcade.astuce_1: Keep your finger on the glass to aim, then let go to drop the claw!
arcade.astuce_2: Big badges are heavy: aim right for the middle, or they'll slip.
arcade.astuce_3: Every achievement you unlock in your games earns you a play. Go play, then come back and see me!
arcade.astuce_4: The pusher only pushes toward the slot: put the arm right behind the pile.
arcade.astuce_5: In practice, 10 tokens caught = 1 free play. Handy, right?
arcade.astuce_6: The machines change every day. Tomorrow, new series!
arcade.astuce_7: In your box, pick a badge and stick it on your Home screen.
arcade.astuce_8: Big badges are won in pieces. Stick them side by side on the Home screen and they join up!
arcade.astuce_9: Rather win big badges in one go? Press X in the hall.
arcade.dire_morceaux: Big badges in pieces, just like in the app! Win each piece, then stick them side by side on the Home screen.
arcade.dire_entiers: Whole big badges! One grab for the entire badge… but they're heavy!
arcade.dire_entrainement: Practice! It's free: 10 tokens caught = 1 free play.

let go to drop the claw.

arcade.gratuit_volonte: Free, as much as you like.
arcade.dire_ici_entraine: Here you practice for free. Aim at a token and let go!
arcade.dire_vide_champion: This machine is empty: you won everything! Bravo, champ!
arcade.dire_plus_parties: You're out of plays… Come back tomorrow, or unlock achievements in your games!
arcade.dire_vise: Aim well, and may the claw be with you!
arcade.dire_pousse: Push gently… everything that falls in the slot is yours!
arcade.dire_refus: Oh no, no more plays! Come back tomorrow, or unlock achievements in your games: each one gives you a play.
arcade.dire_vide_voisine: This machine is empty. Try the one next to it!
arcade.dire_glisse_milieu: It slipped! Grab it right in the middle.
arcade.dire_bonus_jetons: Bravo! 10 tokens: here's a free play!

arcade.dire_ca_bouge: It's moving, it's moving… one more push!
arcade.dire_grand_complet: INCREDIBLE! You've got all the pieces: the big badge is complete!
arcade.dire_un_morceau: A big badge piece! {n} more to find.
arcade.dire_encore_un: Another one for your box! That's quite a pile.
arcade.dire_grand_badge: INCREDIBLE! A big badge! You're a real champ!
arcade.dire_nouvel_accueil: Badges stick on the new Home screen! Choose it in Themes, under the "Home" setting.

bienvenue.intro: Here is what changes in version {version}.
bienvenue.revoir_aide: You can revisit these pages anytime: Settings, SteamU, What’s new.
steamu.nouveautes.aide: This version's welcome screen, page by page.
bienvenue.musiques.texte: The music of The Soundtrack Of Frutiger Aero, by temcandoanything, becomes SteamU's soundtrack, picked by its covers. Thank you, temcandoanything!
bienvenue.place.texte: A little island, a portal… but where does it lead?
bienvenue.mii.texte: An assistant makes it easier to import your Mii.
bienvenue.pause.texte: Pause Games is now part of SteamU: during a game, pause it or not with {Y} in the HOME Menu.
bienvenue.manettes.texte: A new Controllers page shows each controller in its player spot. To change the order, everyone signals from their own controller, and off you go.
bienvenue.amis.texte: Your friends in big tiles, sorted into tabs.
bienvenue.notifications.texte: They gather pile by pile, and the history keeps each day's.
bienvenue.lancement.texte: A new loading screen comes with every game you launch and adapts to its platform.
bienvenue.boutique-greffons.texte: The Decky Store and DeckyHub together, with a showcase of popular, new and recommended plugins. Every page tells you whether the antivirus scanned it.
bienvenue.wifi.texte: Join a Wi-Fi network by typing its password, right from the quick menu.
bienvenue.greffons.texte: Plugins that support it, like Steamcord, get their shortcut in the HOME Menu. Update your plugins from Downloads.
bienvenue.themes.texte: Mark up to 10 themes to switch at every start-up, and choose each one's music, even for your own theme.
bienvenue.menu-rapide.texte: Power saving and a power selector arrive in the quick access menu.
bienvenue.importer: To enjoy it, first import your files: Settings › SteamU › Import.
miimaker.ouvrir_spotpass: Open the Mii Maker SpotPass tab

steamu.guide.cle3ds.6: Already using a 3DS emulator (Citra, Azahar)? Import its aes_keys.txt file too: it unlocks .3ds and .cia games that are still encrypted.
annonces.confidentialite: Receive SteamU announcements. On by default.
credits.logos.marques: The logos are trademarks of their respective owners; SteamU is not affiliated with them.
guide.revoir.aide: Your first steps in SteamU, at your own pace
guide.grille.texte: All your games are organised here, like on the 3DS. Try the buttons below: they change the grid size, just like on your home screen.
guide.grille.bravo: Well done! Try again, or press confirm to continue.
guide.place.texte: Your Mii live here, around your games. They wander, chat and react to what you do.
guide.place.geste: Switch between home and the plaza
guide.spotpass.texte: After importing the real Mii files, you can meet other players’ Mii. Choose your nickname and message, then decide whether to join.
guide.spotpass.carte: Other players’ Mii visit your plaza, and yours visits theirs.
guide.home.texte: HOME: games, apps and help. Quick access: sound, brightness and Decky plugins.
guide.applis.parametres: All of Steam’s settings, organised like on the Wii U.
guide.confid.texte: What your console is allowed to share online. These are your current choices. Adjust them now or change them whenever you like.
guide.nintendo.texte: SteamU contains no Nintendo files. With files from your own consoles, everything comes to life: real sounds, real Mii, Badge Arcade and Luigi’s casino. Choose a folder or a zip: SteamU recognises the files and tells you what is missing.
guide.import.texte: A folder or a zip: SteamU sorts the files and updates this list. You can also continue without importing.
guide.fin.texte: Open this guide again whenever you like: HOME menu, User guide, Help. To ask a question or show your plaza, visit the forum.
guide.applis.essayer: Scroll with the arrows, the D-pad or your finger. Select a card to watch its video.

mii.vie.dessin.texte: What makes them move. SteamU downloads it from the open FFL.js project; nothing about you is sent.
mii.vie.visages.texte: A Nintendo file SteamU is not allowed to give you: FFLResHigh.dat (Wii U) or AFLResHigh_2_3.dat (Miitomo). Copy it to a USB stick or to Downloads. When you import it, SteamU also fetches the Mii bodies.
mii.vie.note.deux: One press: SteamU stores your file, then downloads the Mii renderer, bodies and logo.
mii.vie.note.moteur: The faces are here. Only the Mii drawing is left: one press and SteamU downloads it, along with the bodies.
mii.cours: The Miis are on their way
mii.cours.texte: SteamU downloads the Mii renderer, bodies and logo, then checks each file.
mii.erreur.rien: Nothing was installed: you can try again whenever you like.
mii.la.vie: They are coming to the plaza, and the gate is fixed.
mii.la.moi.texte: This is the one who visits others through SpotPass.
mii.la.sans_moi: You don't have your Mii yet
mii.la.sp: To meet other players' Miis, and send them yours.
mii.la.sp_oui: On: other players' Miis come through the gate.
mii.plus.3ds.texte: Your Mii database, and the ones met through StreetPass. Needs a 3DS with GodMode9.
mii.plus.corps.texte: They could not be downloaded. Without them, SteamU draws its own.
mii.plus.tenues.texte: The Mii Maker body, or an archive to import.
mii.plus.logo.texte: The logo is downloaded after the faces. Retry if the download failed.
mii.plus.note: Everything goes through the same button: Import files.
steamu.reg.doublons.aide: One tile per game found in several stores: the installed copy, otherwise the first store
manettes.aide_ordre: Each player presses {lb}+{rb} on their controller
acces.wifi_indice: Enter the password for this network.
acces.wifi_oublier_texte: You will need to enter the password again to join this network.
